title: Quantile Regression
interviewAnswer: Quantile regression estimates conditional quantiles rather than the conditional mean, making it useful for asymmetric distributions and questions about medians or tails.
keyPoints: Pinball/check loss targets a chosen quantile.
Different quantiles can have different predictor effects.
Useful for prediction intervals and tail planning.
why: Quantile Regression appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
intuition: Pinball/check loss targets a chosen quantile.
deepDive: Quantile regression estimates conditional quantiles rather than the conditional mean, making it useful for asymmetric distributions and questions about medians or tails. Different quantiles can have different predictor effects. Useful for prediction intervals and tail planning. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Predict the 90th percentile delivery time rather than average delivery time for an SLA.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
followUps: What assumptions does Quantile Regression make?
How would you validate or debug Quantile Regression in practice?
production: In production, validate assumptions on real data, monitor the quantities that can drift, and keep a simple baseline so added complexity has a measurable reason to exist.
